scripts.check: npm run check:frontend && npm run check:rust && npm test
scripts.cargo:check: PATH="$PWD/.rust/cargo/bin:$PATH" CARGO_HOME="$PWD/.rust/cargo" RUSTUP_HOME="$PWD/.rust/rustup" cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.cargo:test: PATH="$PWD/.rust/cargo/bin:$PATH" CARGO_HOME="$PWD/.rust/cargo" RUSTUP_HOME="$PWD/.rust/rustup" cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.tauri:build:deb: PATH="$PWD/.rust/cargo/bin:$PATH" CARGO_HOME="$PWD/.rust/cargo" RUSTUP_HOME="$PWD/.rust/rustup" tauri build --bundles deb
